name: Sandstorm
notes: Pebbulk's move 2 (B). A sandstorm whirls up on the 9x9 tiles around the user and stays where it was used for 5 s. Every monster inside it when it starts is blinded for those same 5 s: it can still walk, but it can't use any move until the sand settles. No damage, and the ground never misses. The sand swirls are 2x2 tiles each, so one on every other tile (5 x 5 of them) fills the whole 9x9 area. Wild monsters only use it when the player is within 4 tiles; the player's goes off anyway. Charge: 10 s.
title: SANDSTORM
